title: Winippague (Bergen Island)
summary: Winippague is recorded for Bergen Island in Jamaica Bay, with Wimbaccoe linked as a related form.
history_content: Bergen Island functions as a cross-reference to the fuller Winippague discussion and serves as the modern geographic anchor for the placename.
translation_content:
The name is interpreted as "a fine water-place," from elements glossed as "fine" and "water-place."

Why Place Names Matter

“Place names are essential for wayfinding and communication, helping people navigate and recognize their surroundings. They also represent much more than just geographic markers - they reflect the values of communities and decision-makers at the time they were created and shape how locations are interpreted, remembered, and understood.”

— BC Geographical Names Office, BC Geographical Names Office: Place Names (2026), Place Names section, opening paragraph; page last updated July 22, 2026
preservation_content: Representing Wimbaccoe as a variant of Winippague avoids splitting a single referenced place into duplicate records while keeping the alternate spelling searchable.
whereintheworld_content: Approximate blue/general placement at Bergen Island in Jamaica Bay, based on the place-name cross-reference. Coordinates mark a modern location and are not exact historic coordinates.
